answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that flows like a river: funds move only one way into a time-locked bond tied to a single hardware-verified key, and the bond cannot be split across identities. Creating a thousand Sybils then costs a thousand bonds, while honest agents reclaim theirs after a clean horizon of verified work. Add saffron-tagged spot checks — random audits that slash the bond of any agent caught signing the same transaction twice — so the expected cost of cheating exceeds any gain from duplicate votes.
